MAR.note: Fatourati is a receivables settlement platform, not public procurement.
No central bank role is stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body is mentioned.
No government payment to people is mentioned.
No survey share of adults is given.

facts.fact: CMI says its Fatourati platform connects 32 banks and payment institutions and takes payments through mobile banking, e-banking, wallets, branches and ATMs across more than 70 channels.

MAR.note: Fatourati is said to be used by large public and private actors, with no tax or fee payment to the state stated.
